text:
alex: heads-up — customer reported production build break after upgrading to @redwood-inference/node v2.3.0 on Vercel. esbuild fails during serverless build with weird exports/type errors

maya: can you paste the exact error and their package.json (minimal)?

alex: error snippet:
```
Error: Cannot find module '@redwood-inference/node'
Require stack:
  at Function.Module._resolveFilename (internal/modules/cjs/loader.js:896:15)
  at Module._load (internal/modules/cjs/loader.js:742:27)
  at Module.require (internal/modules/cjs/loader.js:964:19)
  at require (internal/modules/cjs/helpers.js:92:18)
```
package.json minimal from customer:
```json
{
  "name": "acme-app",
  "dependencies": {
    "@redwood-inference/node": "^2.3.0"
  }
}
```

sam: that stack smells like the bundler couldn't pick a CJS entry. we recently moved to conditional exports for import/require. esbuild sometimes resolves differently when using pnpm flat node_modules. which packaging/bundler are they using?

alex: pnpm 8 + next 13 (serverless), esbuild via next's build. they said it works with 2.2.x but breaks on 2.3.0. repro on my machine: `node -e "require('@redwood-inference/node')"` fails after `pnpm install` in a minimal repro.

maya: quick checklist:
- check package.json "exports" entry for conditional map
- ensure there's a top-level "main" fallback for CJS consumers
- types: consumers hitting TS might expect typesVersions or "types" field

eng-platform: digging in the 2.3.0 release — we changed package.json to use an exports map with "import" and "require" subpaths but omitted the legacy "main" key inadvertently. some bundlers (and pnpm peer hoisting) still require it. also noticed we didn't publish a ./package.json export which can break some bundlers that try to require it.

alex: repro steps I used to validate:
1) clone minimal repro repo
2) pnpm install --shamefully-hoist (tried both)
3) node -e "require('@redwood-inference/node')" -> throws
4) npm i @redwood-inference/node@2.2.7 -> works

sam: workaround for customers: pin to 2.2.7 or patch package.json in node_modules to add a "main": "dist/index.cjs.js" entry. also for builders using esbuild add a resolution to force cjs: 
```json
"resolutions": {
  "@redwood-inference/node": "2.2.7"
}
```

maya: small repro snippet that fails for me with 2.3.0:
```js
// index.js
const r = require('@redwood-inference/node')
console.log(typeof r)
```
run: `node index.js` -> throws same Cannot find module. With 2.2.7 it logs 'object'.

eng-platform: created internal issue RNW-512 to track packing fix. immediate plan: cut 2.3.1 with added legacy "main" and include ./package.json in exports, and add types field at top-level for TS consumers. also add a test in our bundler matrix (pnpm + esbuild + next).

support-bot: Ticket SUP-1234 opened with repro, logs, customer contact. Escalation to Releases and Eng Platform.

alex: can we also add a short note in the SDK changelog and support KB so customers hit this less? I'll post a quick message to customers pinned on the ticket.

maya: yes — temporary doc: "If you see module resolution errors after upgrading to 2.3.0, pin to 2.2.7 or add a 'main' fallback in your bundler. We'll ship 2.3.1 in next 24h."

sam: PR drafted to add 'main' fallback + export for ./package.json + types field. tagging @releases for cutoff.

alex: thanks all — marking this thread as triaged. will follow up once 2.3.1 is published. :thumbsup:
